name: apply_url lifeattiktok search id
spec_quote: `https://lifeattiktok.com/search/<id>`, `https://careers.tiktok.com/position/<id>` (also `/resume/<id>/...`) → `https://lifeattiktok.com/resume/<id>/apply`

name: apply_url careers.tiktok with www and http
spec_quote: `www.` is allowed; `http` or `https`.

name: apply_url bytedance en position detail
spec_quote: `https://jobs.bytedance.com/en/position/<id>/detail` (also without `/en`, or `/resume/<id>/apply`) ... → `https://jobs.bytedance.com/en/resume/<id>/apply`

name: apply_url bytedance without en
spec_quote: `https://jobs.bytedance.com/en/position/<id>/detail` (also without `/en`, or `/resume/<id>/apply`) ... → `https://jobs.bytedance.com/en/resume/<id>/apply`

name: apply_url joinbytedance search
spec_quote: `https://joinbytedance.com/search/<id>` → `https://jobs.bytedance.com/en/resume/<id>/apply`

name: apply_url id shorter than 10 digits
spec_quote: `<id>` is a run of at least 10 digits. ... an id shorter than 10 digits ... → null.

name: parse_slots exact banner from spec
args: From 2026-07-01 to 2026-12-31, you can submit up to 2 job applications (including referrals) within the “Undergraduate/Master Intern - 2027 Start” recruitment project. You currently have 1 application(s) remaining.
spec_quote: Reads the form's limit banner, e.g. `From 2026-07-01 to 2026-12-31, you can submit up to 2 job applications (including referrals) within the “Undergraduate/Master Intern - 2027 Start” recruitment project. You currently have 1 application(s) remaining.` → `{limit: 2, project: "Undergraduate/Master Intern - 2027 Start", remaining: 1}`.

name: parse_slots embedded with line breaks and singular application
args:
Intro text
From 2026-07-01 to 2026-12-31,   you can submit up to 3 job application within the "Project Intern - 2027 Start" recruitment project.
You currently have 0 application(s) remaining.
More text
spec_quote: The banner can sit inside other page text; line breaks and repeated spaces anywhere count as one space. ... "application" may be singular.

name: parse_slots no banner
args: Welcome to the application form. Please fill in your details.
spec_quote: No banner (Project Intern and PhD roles have none) → null.

name: parse_slots two digit limit and remaining
args: From 2026-03-01 to 2026-09-30, you can submit up to 10 job applications (including referrals) within the “PhD Researcher - 2027 Start” recruitment project. You currently have 10 application(s) remaining.
spec_quote: Reads the form's limit banner ... → `{limit: 2, project: "Undergraduate/Master Intern - 2027 Start", remaining: 1}`.

name: field_of M.S. abbreviation
spec_quote: `M.S. Applied Data Science` → `Applied Data Science`;

name: field_of B.A. abbreviation
spec_quote: `B.A. Economics` → `Economics`;

name: field_of no abbreviation is trimmed
spec_quote: a string without such an abbreviation is returned trimmed;

name: month without numeric month
spec_quote: Anything without a year+month (`2025`, `Aug 2025`, empty) → `""`.

name: edu_plan basic master and bachelor matches
spec_quote: A matched block → plan item `{idx, school (profile name), degree, field, start, end}` where degree is TikTok's option: master → "Master's degree", bachelor → "Bachelor's degree" ...; field = field_of(profile degree); start/end from the matching wd_education entry

name: edu_plan master Chicago must not match Illinois Chicago
spec_quote: A master-level profile school never matches a block whose text names Illinois / Urbana / UIUC unless the profile school itself is in Illinois (so "University of Illinois Chicago" is not UChicago). ... A block with an empty school or a school not in the profile → a problem string that names the block idx ... A profile school that matched no block → a problem string that names the school.

name: edu_plan empty school block is a problem
spec_quote: A block with an empty school or a school not in the profile → a problem string that names the block idx; it is not in the plan.

name: edu_plan unmatched profile school is a problem
spec_quote: A profile school that matched no block → a problem string that names the school.

name: edu_plan associate and mba degree mapping with no wd match
spec_quote: ... associate → "Associate degree"; field = field_of(profile degree); start/end from the matching wd_education entry ("" when none matches).

name: lang_plan basic Mandarin and English matches
spec_quote: A block whose language matches a `match` regex (case-insensitive) → `{idx, language, proficiency: tiktok}`;

name: lang_plan Cantonese matches chinese entry
spec_quote: "Mandarin" or "Cantonese" also match an entry whose `match` contains "chinese".

name: lang_plan no match and missing tiktok level are problems
spec_quote: No match, or a matching entry without a `tiktok` level → a problem naming the block idx.

name: work_plan basic internship and work matches
spec_quote: A block whose company matches a `match` regex (case-insensitive) → `{idx, kind, title, start: month(From), end: month(To)}`;

name: work_plan unmatched company is a problem naming idx and company
spec_quote: otherwise a problem naming the block idx and the company.

name: work_plan case-insensitive company and alternate month formats
spec_quote: A block whose company matches a `match` regex (case-insensitive) → `{idx, kind, title, start: month(From), end: month(To)}`;

name: same whitespace-normalized case-insensitive equality
spec_quote: Whitespace-normalized, case-insensitive equality.

name: same phone last ten digits
spec_quote: If `want` looks like a phone number (only digits, spaces, `()+.-`, at least 7 characters) the last 10 digits are compared.

name: same multi-select sorted parts
spec_quote: If either side contains " | " (a multi-select), compare the sorted parts.
